blurb:
Laredos on Sandy Plains is the kind of neighborhood Mexican spot you want to have in your back pocket. Colorful inside, decorated well, and it doesn't take itself too seriously. Good for a weeknight dinner when you don't want to cook, or a casual weekend meal where you want a margarita with your food without it being a whole production.

They run the classic Mexican menu here and do it well. The margaritas are the thing people mention most. Not fancy, not overpriced, just a solid drink that goes with chips and salsa the way it should. The price point is easy too, so you can bring the whole family and not wince when the check comes.

They're open every day starting at 11am, which means they also work as a lunch option if you're in that part of Marietta.

blurb:
Lemon Grass on Roswell Road is the Thai spot my wife and I keep coming back to. It's in a shopping center but the inside is spacious and comfortable, red decor throughout, and it actually feels like a sit-down dinner rather than a quick takeout stop. Good for a weeknight date night or a dinner where you want something a little more interesting than the usual rotation.

The noodle dishes and curries are what they do well here, which covers a lot of ground. The classics all show up on the menu and they execute them consistently. If you want something filling and flavorful without a lot of fuss, this place delivers.

A couple of things worth knowing: they close in the afternoon between lunch and dinner service, so don't show up at 4pm expecting to get in. They're also closed Sundays and no Saturday lunch, so dinner is your window on weekends.

blurb:
Hamp and Harry's is right off Roswell Street in Marietta and it's been a go-to for brunch in our area for good reason. The service is warm, the food is solid, and it's the kind of place where you actually feel taken care of instead of just processed through a table turn. Good for a relaxed weekend brunch or a casual lunch with someone you want to catch up with.

The fried chicken biscuit is what people order and for good reason. Hot, fluffy biscuit, big portion, and the kind of thing that makes you want to skip the gym and not feel bad about it. The salad dressing has also been called out specifically by people who've been, which is a detail I always notice because it usually means the kitchen is paying attention to the small stuff.

Just know they're closed Mondays, so plan accordingly.

blurb:
If you've got kids who need to burn energy or a group that needs something more interesting than dinner and a movie, Andretti on Roswell Road is worth knowing about. It's a big operation with go-karts, arcade games, a full bar, and enough going on that adults actually have fun too. We went on a busy weekend and the place was packed, but that's kind of the vibe here. It's loud, it's lively, and it works for birthday parties, team outings, or just a night where you want something different.

If the kart lines are long, don't just stand around. Grab a game card, pull up a stool at the bar, and order a drink. On the visit we've heard the most about, a bartender named Khalia was running the ground floor bar and people were raving about her. Attentive even when the place was slammed. That kind of service is what makes you want to come back.

Fridays and Saturdays they're open until 1am, so this one works as a late-night option too, not just an afternoon thing.

blurb:
This place on Powers Ferry is one of those spots that puts you in a good mood the second you walk in. It's cheerful, it smells incredible, and it's the kind of morning stop that makes you feel like you did something right. Good for a casual breakfast, a coffee break, or grabbing something sweet to bring home to the family.

They do Brazilian light bites alongside a solid spread of traditional cakes and cookies. If you haven't had Brazilian baked goods before, this is a great first look. My wife is the one who found this spot and she has not stopped talking about it since. The pastries are the move here.

They're open seven days a week starting at 6:30am most mornings, so it works whether you're an early riser or just someone who needs something good before noon.
